title: Eleven Seconds in a Doorway
subtitle: 挫折振作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 挫折振作（做人与做事·挫折与失败）
meta: 主题语境：挫折振作（做人与做事·挫折与失败）　|　核心词汇：thought　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thought 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① thought that finished him, as he told it, took eleven seconds: he was thirty-one, standing in a doorway in the rain, and he decided that the failure of the shop was not a thing that had happened to him but a thing that he was. He said a ② thought you do not examine is a thought that examines you, and that his had examined him for eleven years before he noticed.

His ③ thoughts on the matter, written down eleven years later in a notebook nobody had asked for, are dull and useful, and I will summarise them: a failure is an event, not an identity, and the thought had come to him fully made, which is how you can tell it was false. He had had no ④ thought for anybody else that winter, not for my mother, who kept the house, and not for me, who was eleven, and he said so, which was the first useful thing he did.

He was ⑤ lost in thought for eleven weeks, sitting in the same chair, and my mother let him, which I took for cruelty and was patience. Then, ⑥ on second thought, he got up on a Tuesday, walked to the town and asked for work at the yard, and they gave him eleven weeks of it, and he stayed nineteen years.

What nobody had ⑦ given a thought to, including him, was that the yard was the making of him: he liked the work and he was good at it. The ⑧ thought of going back into a shop, he said afterwards, was the only thing that ever frightened him, and it was eleven years before he could say that out loud.

The ⑨ thought I keep, out of all of it, is not his but hers: she said a person in trouble does not need advice, they need somebody to sit in the same room, and the thought of it still frightens me. My ⑩ thoughts on that have changed twice, and I am forty-one. He died in 2003. In the doorway in the rain, at thirty-one, he was wrong about himself, and it took him eleven seconds to be wrong and nineteen years to find out.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （一个具体的）念头；一闪而过的想法
C. n. （对人的）关心；体谅；顾及
D. n. 看法；见解（thoughts on ...）
E. 固定搭配：lost in thought 陷入沉思
F. 固定搭配：on second thought(s) 转念一想；再一想
G. 固定搭配：give ... a thought 考虑一下；想一想
H. 固定搭配：the thought of ... 一想到……

items.q: The thought that finished him, as he told it
a thought you do not examine is a thought
His thoughts on the matter, written down
He had had no thought for anybody else
He was lost in thought for eleven weeks
on second thought, he got up on a Tuesday
given a thought to, including him
The thought of going back into a shop
The thought I keep, out of all of it
My thoughts on that have changed twice

answers.why: the thought 意为“念头、想法”，据他自己说，压垮他的那个念头只用了十一秒。
a thought 意为“（一个具体的）念头”，他说你不审视的念头会反过来审视你。
thoughts on the matter 意为“对这件事的看法”，他十一年后写下的看法平淡而有用。
no thought for ... 意为“对……毫不关心、毫不顾及”，那年冬天他对任何人都不闻不问。
lost in thought 意为“陷入沉思”，他坐在同一把椅子上陷入了沉思，整整十一个星期。
on second thought 意为“转念一想”，转念一想，他在一个周二起了身，去镇上的场院找工作。
give ... a thought 意为“考虑一下、想一想”，谁也没有想过——包括他自己——那个场院成就了他。
the thought of ... 意为“一想到……”，他说一想到要回店里，那是唯一让他害怕的事。
the thought 意为“念头、想法”，我至今保留着的那个念头不是他的，而是她的。
thoughts on that 意为“对那件事的看法”，我对那句话的看法变过两次。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他说，你不审视的念头，会反过来审视你。（thought）
他十一年后写下的看法平淡而有用：失败是事件，不是身份。（thoughts on）
那年冬天他对任何人都不闻不问，他承认了这一点。（thought）
他坐在同一把椅子上陷入了沉思，我母亲由着他。（lost in thought）
转念一想，他在一个周二起了身，去镇上的场院找工作。（on second thought）
谁也没有想过，包括他自己，那个场院成就了他。（give ... a thought）
answers: He said a thought you do not examine is a thought that examines you.
His thoughts on the matter, written down eleven years later, are dull and useful: a failure is an event, not an identity.
He had had no thought for anybody else that winter, and he said so.
He was lost in thought in the same chair, and my mother let him.
Then, on second thought, he got up on a Tuesday and asked for work at the yard.
What nobody had given a thought to, including him, was that the yard was the making of him.
